items.q: What happens after I submit the form?
items.a: We review every request personally and reply within 3-5 business days, usually with a few clarifying questions or a proposed consultation time.

items.q: What information is most helpful to include?
items.a: Your city, approximate number of employees, project timeline, and a plain description of the problem or goal — for example slow Wi-Fi, a new office, or a firewall upgrade.
Yes. The initial consultation is free and comes with no obligation. If a full network assessment is useful, we will quote it clearly before starting.
